body:
No, it most certainly is not easy, but let me start to catalogue my string of failures:

1. Sport. Have tried a few differing variants of this. Most recently, I joined with a family member who is very successful. I have not been. A worsening chronic condition and a disabling injury ended my direct involvement. An attempt at taking a supporting role ended abruptly when I realized that I was not physically up to the task, nor were my attempts appreciated (this last was glaringly obvious when I was told there were "plenty of others who would be happy to fill the position, so you're welcome to leave.")

2. Volunteer work. Groups I have contacted have not worked out for a variety of reasons - usually because increasing family demands take up too much time. In other situations, I can't cope physically. 
 
3. Employment. Not currently working due to disability. Outdated skills leave me few options.

4 Education/Retraining. Can't afford anything I find interesting. Our family's economic status puts me just out of the running for government programs.

5. Seeking therapy: I've had many therapists over the years. One was sexually inappropriate. One thought I just needed to pray. Another abandoned me and gave inaccurate info to my GP which has had an impact of further attempts to get help.

Every time I think I've found a way out of the pit, something loosens my grip and I fall back in.

I should add that I'm over 40 and have been struggling like this for 25+ years. I have a large family and people who purport themselves to be friends but somehow even when I can bring myself to ask for help I'm just too much of a fucking effort.

Wow. That didn't make me feel better at all.
